description: This Swift source file defines the 'GatewayEndpointStore' actor which manages the resolution, publication, and lifecycle of the gateway control endpoint in an application. It includes mechanisms for observing state changes, configuring connection parameters, handling remote tunnel setup, and generating related URLs. The file also includes enums for state management and extension methods for configuration and testing.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointState
classes.description: An enum representing the various states of the gateway endpoint, including ready, connecting, and unavailable states with associated data.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: An actor that manages the lifecycle, configuration, and publication of the gateway control endpoint, supporting observers and remote tunnel management.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of state updates, allowing observers to subscribe to changes in the endpoint state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the endpoint state by re-evaluating connection parameters.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the connection mode (local, remote, unconfigured) and updates the endpoint state accordingly.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures the remote control tunnel is established, returning the port number.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration details for the current gateway endpoint, throwing errors if unavailable.

methods.name: cancelRemoteEnsure
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing remote tunnel setup process.

methods.name: kickRemoteEnsureIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates a remote tunnel setup if none is in progress, updating the state to connecting.

methods.name: ensureRemoteConfig
methods.description: Ensures configuration is available for remote mode, establishing tunnels if necessary.

methods.name: requireRemoteMode
methods.description: Checks that the current mode is remote, throwing an error if not.

methods.name: resolveDirectRemoteURL
methods.description: Resolves the direct remote URL if transport is 'direct'.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the state update list.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the internal state and notifies subscribers, with logging.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Attempts to fall back to local tailnet address if in local mode and bind mode supports it.

methods.name: resolveGatewayBindMode
methods.description: Resolves the gateway bind mode from environment and configuration.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCustomBindHost
methods.description: Resolves a custom bind host from configuration.

methods.name: resolveGatewayScheme
methods.description: Determines the scheme ('ws' or 'wss') based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveLocalGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines the local host address based on bind mode, custom host, and tailscale IP.

methods.name: localConfig
methods.description: Generates a local gateway connection configuration based on current settings and environment.

methods.name: dashboardURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the gateway dashboard, adjusting scheme and path based on configuration and mode.
